name: done-chime
description: Plays a sound when Claude Code finishes a reply, needs your permission, or stops on an error. Custom sounds in any common format, three built-in packs, volume and per-event switches. Windows, macOS and Linux.

sound_pack.title: Sound pack
sound_pack.description: Built-in sounds used when no custom file is set: chime (bell), soft (gentle sine) or arcade (8-bit)

play_done.title: Sound when Claude finishes
play_done.description: Plays when Claude stops and hands control back to you

play_attention.title: Sound when Claude needs you
play_attention.description: Plays when Claude waits for your permission or a form

play_error.title: Sound on errors
play_error.description: Plays when a reply stops on an API error

min_seconds.title: Minimum task length (seconds)
min_seconds.description: Only play the finish sound when the turn took at least this long; 0 plays it every time

done_sound.title: Custom finish sound
done_sound.description: Audio or video file (wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, opus...); empty uses the pack

attention_sound.title: Custom attention sound
attention_sound.description: Audio or video file (wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, opus...); empty uses the pack

error_sound.title: Custom error sound
error_sound.description: Audio or video file (wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, opus...); empty uses the pack
